meaning: The name you pick to sign in to an account and be known by on a site.
clues: It is a name that belongs to one person, not to a website.
You choose it when you set up an account. It is the name others see beside your posts, not an address for mail.
It can be made up, like GardenFan42, instead of your real name.
On many sites, you type it with your password to sign in.
It is one word with eight letters and starts with U.
assumes: An email address has an @ sign in it
A domain name is the name of a website
A PIN is a short secret number

decoys.meaning: An address for sending mail online. It has a name, an @ sign, and the mail company's name.
The words in a website's address, which people type instead of a long number.
A short secret number, often four digits, used to unlock a phone or use a card.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, I was just "Floyd, disk number four." You get to pick your own name now?

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Yes! Tip: skip your full name and birth year, and pick something made up.
